MaxExhaustion.Name: Maximum Exhaustion
MaxExhaustion.Hint: The maximum exhaustion level the panel can apply (1–6).

AllowSixthLevel.Name: Allow deadly (6th) level
AllowSixthLevel.Hint: When disabled, the panel will not raise exhaustion above the maximum and warns the GM.

Step.Name: Manual step
Step.Hint: How many levels the "Apply exhaustion now" button adds.

ChatMode.Name: Chat messages
ChatMode.Hint: Where to post exhaustion change messages.

CigaretteName.Name: Cigarette item name
CigaretteName.Hint: An item with this name (case-insensitive) counts as a "Red Powder" cigarette.

DeleteEmptyStack.Name: Delete empty stack
DeleteEmptyStack.Hint: Delete the cigarette item when its quantity drops to zero.

SkillSortMode.Name: Skill sorting
SkillSortMode.Hint: The order of skills on the character sheet.
